sql: SELECT p.id FROM people p WHERE p.workspace_id = $1 AND p.merged_into IS NULL AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM identities i WHERE i.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND i.person_id = p.id AND i.kind = $2::text) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM identities i WHERE i.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND i.person_id = p.id AND i.kind = $3::text) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM identities i WHERE i.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND i.person_id = p.id AND i.kind = $4::text) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM identities i WHERE i.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND i.person_id = p.id AND i.kind = $5::text)))
